pt.r: O Parque Nacional de Shenandoah fica na Virgínia, nos Estados Unidos. Tem 805 km² e está protegido desde 1935, sob gestão do Serviço Nacional de Parques dos EUA (NPS). Na classificação da IUCN, está na categoria II, a dos parques nacionais: protege ecossistemas inteiros e recebe visitantes.
pt.h: Criado em 26/12/1935, com a remoção de centenas de famílias que viviam nas montanhas. A Civilian Conservation Corps construiu boa parte da estrada Skyline e das instalações nos anos 1930.
pt.ff: Parque longo e estreito na Blue Ridge, entre o vale do Shenandoah e o Piedmont da Virgínia. Quase 40% é área selvagem, com florestas de folhosas que se recuperaram do corte, cachoeiras, ursos-negros e cervos-de-cauda-branca.
at: Old Rag e sua escalada em rocha

en.r: Shenandoah National Park is a national park in Virginia, United States. It covers 805 km² and has been protected since 1935. It is managed by the U.S. National Park Service. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: Created on 26 December 1935, with the removal of hundreds of families who lived in the mountains. The Civilian Conservation Corps built much of Skyline Drive and its facilities in the 1930s.
en.ff: A long, narrow park on the Blue Ridge, between the Shenandoah Valley and the Virginia Piedmont. Almost 40% is wilderness, with hardwood forests recovered from logging, waterfalls, black bears and white-tailed deer.

es.ff: Parque largo y angosto en la Blue Ridge, entre el valle del Shenandoah y el Piedmont de Virginia. Casi el 40% es área silvestre, con bosques de frondosas recuperados de la tala, cascadas, osos negros y ciervos de cola blanca.

en.h: A 1,321-acre park in Westmoreland County, Virginia, with 1.5 miles of Potomac shore on the Northern Neck. Opened in June 1936, it was the sixth of Virginia's original state parks. It is near George Washington's birthplace and Stratford Hall, birthplace of Robert E. Lee.
en.ff: Horsehead Cliffs look over the Potomac; fossils and a beach lie at their base.
